title: Pelerin - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Pelerin in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Absorbs Ice, so an ice-based Lune build is a liability against it.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toFire
ResistsNone
AbsorbsIce
ImmuneNone

Bring Fire damage. Ice is absorbed - using it heals the target.

sections.title: How to Beat the Pelerin
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Fire is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It absorbs Ice, so that element heals it rather than hurting it.
